A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 19-page IEC study, including readable equations, Tables 1–5, Figures 1–11, and Appendix A. Pages 2–19 have identical extracted text and rendered content; page 1 differs only in author-name and arXiv stamp text.

before.justification: v1 reports original IEC experiments in Tables 1–4, timestep and iteration ablations in Figure 3, and overhead measurements and generated-image comparisons in Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains the original IEC experiments, ablations, overhead measurements, and qualitative comparisons from v1.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 retains the same IEC update, initialization, stopping conditions, and inference procedure. No method component is added or revised.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same image-generation tasks on CIFAR-10, LSUN-Churchs, LSUN-Bedrooms, ImageNet, and MS-COCO. Appendix examples cover the same datasets and scenarios.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain timestep-wise quantization, DeepCache, CacheQuant, and the same original-model reference rows. Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the tables and appendix figures.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same generation counts: 5,000 images for MS-COCO and 50,000 otherwise. Metrics, sampling steps, quantization and caching configurations, and IEC application rules are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Figures 1–3 retain the same spectral-norm analysis, error trajectories, and timestep/iteration ablations. Appendix A preserves the same overhead analysis and qualitative comparisons.

E5.justification: Both versions state that Figure 1 averages over 100 sample generations. Neither adds seed information, independent-run variability, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples in Tables 1–5 and Figures 1–11 are unchanged. For example, both versions report CIFAR-10 W8A8 FID of 4.32 without IEC and 3.76 with IEC in Table 1.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, error-propagation derivations, contraction argument, and claimed linear error-growth analysis in Sections 3.1–3.2 are identical. No assumptions or proofs are added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about test-time correction without retraining, exponential-to-linear error reduction, and generation-quality improvements across efficient diffusion models.

C2.justification: The interpretations of selective correction and computational overhead remain unchanged. Both retain the W4A8 collapse observation for LSUN-Bedrooms and the resource-limited future-work discussion in Section 5.

D1.justification: Both disclose the same PyTorch/NVIDIA 3090 setup, quantization granularity, caching configuration, and IEC parameters: lambda 0.5, maximum iteration count 1, and threshold 1e-5. No implementation or code/data access information is added.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, and related-work discussion are identical. The positioning of IEC as a test-time correction for structural efficiency methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: Page 1 changes the second author's name from Yanwei Qi to Weiqi Yan and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose, section organization, and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures and tables retain identical content, captions, styling, and placement. There is no structural layout change; rendered pages 2–19 are identical.

improvement.justification: The revision only updates the author name and arXiv version/date information. With identical scientific text, theoretical reasoning, experiments, limitations, and appendix evidence, the paper's substantive quality remains unchanged.
